sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Silver-Plated Designer Nath – Sparkling White Zirconia Studded
sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your ethnic look with this stunning silver-toned nath, featuring a brilliant cluster of white stones and a delicate teardrop charm. To maintain its radiant sparkle and high-fashion finish, avoid contact with moisture and perfumes, and store it in a dry, safe place after each wear.
